scenarios.name: source absence: CONCAT omission and blank members
evidence: Project change-list contract: evaluating implicit blank input cells must not create authored cells; normal and overlay execution publish the same changes. Text x for this exact CONCAT probe was independently corroborated during issue005; see concat-members.json evidence.

scenarios.name: source absence: scalar predicate
evidence: Project contract: reads preserve implicit blank values and source absence; predicate, selector and branch consumers preserve blank identity. SUM ignores text range members and LEN of blank is zero. Public workflow tests separately assert raw changes never author the absent input.
